errors.message: Row tag omission (empty row tag name) cannot be used with attribute-centric FOR XML serialization.
ROOT name 'x y' contains an invalid XML identifier as required by FOR XML; ' '(0x0020) is the first character at fault.
Row name 'a b' contains an invalid XML identifier as required by FOR XML; ' '(0x0020) is the first character at fault.
Column name 'a' is repeated. The same attribute cannot be generated more than once on the same XML tag.
Unnamed tables cannot be used as XML identifiers as well as unnamed columns cannot be used for attribute names. Name unnamed columns/tables using AS in the SELECT statement.

FOR XML EXPLICIT and RAW modes currently do not support addressing binary data as URLs in column 'b'. Remove the column, or use the BINARY BASE64 mode, or create the URL directly using the 'dbobject/TABLE[@PK1="V1"]/@COLUMN' syntax.

errors.message: FOR XML EXPLICIT requires at least three columns, including the tag column, the parent column, and at least one data column.
FOR XML AUTO requires at least one table for generating XML tags. Use FOR XML RAW or add a FROM clause with a table name.
Row tag name is only allowed with RAW or PATH mode of FOR XML.
